dict.string: Rest the cursor on a folder to see what's inside. MIT license, © 2026 Glimpse contributors.
Glimpse lists what is inside a folder in your Documents when you rest the cursor on it in a Finder window. It never changes your files.
Glimpse lists what is inside a folder in your Downloads when you rest the cursor on it in a Finder window. It never changes your files.
Glimpse lists what is inside a folder on an external drive when you rest the cursor on it in a Finder window. It never changes your files.
Glimpse lists what is inside a folder on a network drive when you rest the cursor on it in a Finder window. It never changes your files.
Glimpse lists what is inside a desktop folder when you rest the cursor on it. It never changes your files.
